The cited item must carry one of the value's causes: LIFE items carry causes read from their event text (not the Interpretation); IDENTITY Age carries ageing/hormones (45+) or youth (<30); Nationality/Hometown carry genetics/climate; SOUL carries temperament/stress/low-mood.
